Blocks.Section: Sync CRM ACL Assignees
Blocks.Text: ACL assignees are members of an ACL. You can use the endpoints and methods defined in this document to establish and manage ACLs throughout the integration lifecycle.

Blocks.Section: Sync CRM ACL Assignees
Blocks.Text: ACLs are a relationship between a atsEntityId and atsEntityAclId. The atsEntityId represents the entity which needs restricted visibility and the atsEntityAcl is the identifier of the list of users which will have access.

Blocks.Section: Sync CRM ACL Assignees
Blocks.Text: For broader context on how ACLs are defined across multiple endpoints, see Sync ACLs Overview.
